"""Observe raw/clean support without changing existing Foam owner decisions."""
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from collections import Counter
import hashlib,json
import cv2
import numpy as np
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision import foam_front_detector as owner
from oil_tracker.adapters.storage.json_recipe_repository import JsonRecipeRepository

root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
prior_path=root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-foam-cross-appearance-support.json'
prior=load(prior_path);frames=[420,450,480,1620,1635,1665,1680]
reply_path=root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-foam-upper-visibility-reply.json'
reply=load(reply_path)
folder=root/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-implementation-20261009-001/v2-sample4-scoped-FULL'
trace=next(folder.glob('oil-debug*/debug_trace.jsonl'))
records={r['frame_index']:r for r in map(json.loads,trace.read_text().splitlines())}
saved={r['frame_index']:r for r in load(folder/'foam.json')}
recipe_path=root/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-exclusion-20261009-001/sample4-baseline/recipe.oilrecipe'
paths=[trace,folder/'foam.json',recipe_path,prior_path,reply_path,Path(__file__)]
keys=['original_roi','grayscale','canny','glare_mask','effective_mask','foam_component_labels']
for f in frames:
    paths += [trace.parent/records[f]['images'][key] for key in keys]
inputs={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in paths}
for p,h in inputs.items():
    if p in prior['input_sha256s']:assert h==prior['input_sha256s'][p],p
source_pins=prior['preflight']['sources']
def verify():
    for name,pin in {**inputs,**source_pins}.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
verify()
pre=dict(schema='s11-foam-gap-cleanup-preflight-v1',base_head='98466befb24c6b8777c9b12cd45219144a3b49a7',
    inputs=inputs,source_pins=source_pins,frames=frames,human_reply=reply,
    hypothesis='A narrow visible gap may be joined during support cleanup; distinguish raw membership absence, cleanup additions, lateral component joins and extreme-row selection.',
    method='Capture unchanged raw-white and cleaned-white masks from the first actual _clean_support_mask call. Compare every retained label/raster to saved metadata. Record every fully visible bounded vertical raw gap wholly filled by cleanup and raw component IDs joined into a clean component.',
    falsification='If the apparent upper-region gap survives cleanup, do not attribute the missing front to gap fill. A raw support membership gap is not certified air. No morphology parameter changes, threshold sweep or automatic upper-front substitution.',
    production_change=False,frame_decode=False,isolated_foam_owner_replay=True)
assert not (out/'preflight.json').exists();(out/'preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(pre,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
settings=JsonRecipeRepository().load(recipe_path).glasses[0].detector_settings
clean=owner._clean_support_mask;cases=[]
for f in frames:
    record=records[f];diag=saved[f];assert not diag['truncated']
    images={k:cv2.imread(str(trace.parent/record['images'][k]),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED) for k in keys}
    observed=[]
    def capture_clean(mask,base):
        result=clean(mask,base);observed.append((mask.copy(),result.copy()));return result
    with patch.object(owner,'_clean_support_mask',capture_clean):
        result=owner.detect_bottom_connected_foam(images['original_roi'],images['grayscale'],images['canny'],images['glare_mask'],images['effective_mask'],settings,capture_diagnostics=True)
    labels=images['foam_component_labels'];assert np.array_equal(result.diagnostic_labels,labels),f
    for k,v in result.diagnostics.items():
        if k=='components':
            assert len(v)==len(diag[k])
            for a,b in zip(v,diag[k],strict=True):assert all(b[key]==value for key,value in a.items()),f
        else:assert v==diag[k],(f,k)
    raw,cleaned=(a>0 for a in observed[0]);visible=(images['effective_mask']>0)&(images['glare_mask']==0)
    _,raw_ids,raw_stats,_=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(raw.astype(np.uint8),connectivity=8)
    _,clean_ids,clean_stats,_=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(cleaned.astype(np.uint8),connectivity=8)
    ox,oy=diag['crop_origin'];gaps=[]
    for x in range(raw.shape[1]):
        ys=np.flatnonzero(raw[:,x])
        for a,b in zip(ys[:-1],ys[1:]):
            if b<=a+1 or not visible[a:b+1,x].all():continue
            if cleaned[a:b+1,x].all():
                gaps.append(dict(source_x=int(x+ox),gap_source_y_range=[int(a+1+oy),int(b+oy)],
                                 raw_ids=[int(raw_ids[a,x]),int(raw_ids[b,x])],clean_id=int(clean_ids[a,x]),
                                 final_ids=sorted(map(int,np.unique(labels[a:b+1,x])))))
    transitions=[]
    for c in diag['components']:
        mask=labels==c['diagnostic_id']
        parents=Counter(map(int,raw_ids[mask & raw]))
        transitions.append(dict(diagnostic_id=c['diagnostic_id'],selected=c['selected_component'],
             source_bbox=c['source_bbox_xyxy'],source_front_y=c['source_front_y'],
             raw_parent_pixels=dict(parents),raw_parent_count=len(parents),
             added_pixels=int((mask & ~raw).sum()),retained_pixels=int(mask.sum()),
             lower=c['predicates']['front_from_lower_edge']))
    np.savez_compressed(out/f'capture-f{f}.npz',raw_white=raw,clean_white=cleaned,raw_ids=raw_ids,clean_ids=clean_ids,labels=labels,visible=visible)
    case=dict(frame_index=f,time_sec=f/30,raw_white_pixels=int(raw.sum()),clean_white_pixels=int(cleaned.sum()),
         cleanup_calls=len(observed),raw_component_count=len(raw_stats)-1,clean_component_count=len(clean_stats)-1,
         filled_vertical_gaps=gaps,component_parents=transitions)
    cases.append(case)
    print(f,'raw CC',len(raw_stats)-1,'clean CC',len(clean_stats)-1,'filled gaps',len(gaps))
    print('selected',next(c for c in transitions if c['selected']))
verify()
report=dict(schema='s11-foam-gap-cleanup-audit-v1',preflight=pre,preflight_sha256=sha(out/'preflight.json'),
    cases=cases,inputs_preserved=True,source_unchanged=True,exact_foam_replays=len(cases),
    script=Path(__file__).read_text(),outputs={p.name:sha(p) for p in sorted(out.glob('capture-f*.npz'))})
(out/'capture.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

bracket_preflight.policy: All retained components and occupied columns. Retain every adjacent falling/rising signed peak pair with observed flanks/corridor and lower raw minimum. No selected front, physical classifier, smoothing, width/strength cutoff or threshold search.
bracket_preflight.difference: Preserve polarity and two flanks rather than merging opposite slopes into one unsigned plateau; all tied intervals remain.
bracket_preflight.controls: 14/15/16 s qualitative Foam and rim, 54/55.5/56 s visible upper Foam and internal-texture negatives, unreviewed 54.5 s. No exact-coordinate truth inferred.
bracket_preflight.output_before_measurement: Support-top anchoring and masks can miss the visible front. A dark trough or a paired edge is not air/Foam identity; all outputs remain unresolved.

"""Frozen seven-frame ordered-gap observation; no physical selector."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
from collections import Counter
import cv2
from tests.diagnostics import s11_foam_front_alternatives as probe

root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
capture=load(out/'capture.json');inputs=dict(capture['preflight']['inputs'])
paths=[out/'capture.json',out/'preflight.json',Path(__file__),Path(probe.__file__),
       root/'tests/unit/test_s11_foam_gap_brackets.py',
       root/'docs/20-architecture/s11-foam-component-diagnostics-architecture.md']
inputs.update({str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in paths})
def verify():
    for name,pin in {**inputs,**capture['preflight']['source_pins']}.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
verify()
pre=dict(schema='s11-ordered-gap-preflight-v1',base_head='98466befb24c6b8777c9b12cd45219144a3b49a7',
    frames=capture['preflight']['frames'],radii_px=[4,8],inputs=inputs,
    policy='All retained components and occupied columns. Retain every adjacent falling/rising signed peak pair with observed flanks/corridor and lower raw minimum. No selected front, physical classifier, smoothing, width/strength cutoff or threshold search.',
    difference='Preserve polarity and two flanks rather than merging opposite slopes into one unsigned plateau; all tied intervals remain.',
    controls='14/15/16 s qualitative Foam and rim, 54/55.5/56 s visible upper Foam and internal-texture negatives, unreviewed 54.5 s. No exact-coordinate truth inferred.',
    output_before_measurement='Support-top anchoring and masks can miss the visible front. A dark trough or a paired edge is not air/Foam identity; all outputs remain unresolved.')
assert not (out/'bracket-preflight.json').exists();(out/'bracket-preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(pre,indent=2)+'\n')
trace_name=next(n for n in inputs if n.endswith('debug_trace.jsonl'));trace=root/trace_name
records={r['frame_index']:r for r in map(json.loads,trace.read_text().splitlines())}
cases=[]
for f in pre['frames']:
    rec=records[f]
    def raster(key):return cv2.imread(str(trace.parent/rec['images'][key]),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
    result=probe.measure(raster('grayscale'),raster('foam_component_labels'),raster('effective_mask')>0,
                         raster('glare_mask')>0,origin=(543,798),include_gap_brackets=True)
    result['frame_index']=f
    for c in result['components']:
        c['bracket_counts']={str(r):dict(Counter(len(col['views'][i]['gap_brackets']) for col in c['columns'])) for i,r in enumerate(probe.RADII)}
    cases.append(result)
    print('FRAME',f,[(c['component_id'],len(c['columns']),c['bracket_counts']) for c in result['components']])

"""Render saved upper-region comparisons, never an accepted contour."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,json,hashlib
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR','/tmp/oil-foam-gap-mpl')
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import cv2
import numpy as np

out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root=Path.cwd()/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-implementation-20261009-001/v2-sample4-scoped-FULL'
result=json.loads((out/'brackets.json').read_text())
capture=json.loads((out/'capture.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def original(f):
    p=next(root.glob(f'oil-debug*/frames/*/f{f:09d}_*/original_roi*.png'))
    assert sha(p)==result['preflight']['inputs'][str(p.relative_to(Path.cwd()))]
    return cv2.cvtColor(cv2.imread(str(p)),cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,4,figsize=(13,8))
for row,f in enumerate([1620,1665,1680]):
    p=out/f'capture-f{f}.npz';assert sha(p)==capture['outputs'][p.name]
    a=np.load(p);rgb=original(f)
    for col,(name,array) in enumerate([('Original',rgb),('Raw white',a['raw_white']),('Cleaned white',a['clean_white']),('Retained labels',a['labels'])]):
        ax=axes[row,col];ax.imshow(array,extent=[543,647,902,798],interpolation='nearest')
        ax.set_xlim(555,635);ax.set_ylim(841,799);ax.set_title(f'{f/30:g}s {name}')
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(out/'cleanup-comparison.png',dpi=130);plt.close(fig)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(12,7))
for col,f in enumerate([1620,1665,1680]):
    case=next(c for c in result['cases'] if c['frame_index']==f)
    comp=next(c for c in case['components'] if c['component_id']==1);rgb=original(f)
    for row in range(2):
        ax=axes[row,col];ax.imshow(rgb,extent=[543,647,902,798],interpolation='nearest')
        ax.set_xlim(555,635);ax.set_ylim(839,798)
        ax.set_title(f'{f/30:g}s '+('Original' if row==0 else 'All dark-gap edge pairs, radius 8'))
        if row:
            for column in comp['columns']:
                x=column['source_x']
                for pair in column['views'][1]['gap_brackets']:
                    for key,color in [('upper_edge_source_y_range','#fb66d4'),('lower_edge_source_y_range','#22efff')]:
                        y0,y1=pair[key];ax.plot([x,x],[y0,y1-1],color=color,marker='.',markersize=2,linewidth=.8)
fig.suptitle('Unselected alternatives: magenta falling edge / cyan rising edge\nNo physical classification, fitted curve or Foam scalar')
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,.93]);fig.savefig(out/'brackets-review.png',dpi=145);plt.close(fig)
print('Saved original/raw/clean support and unselected bracket comparisons')
